summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. All changes are additive; nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and the code were not run, per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Choices to review: io.open is used to avoid the builtin shadowing; mode, name, and truncate are overridden on the reader because BinaryIO declares them abstract; the module-level open implementation types mode as Any so it can call the overloaded Progress.open; only the suppressions the spec lists for the reader are added. One criterion is untested: text-mode buffering above 1 forwarded to the handle, which would need a mock on io.open.
